item.title: Black Student Union Sankofa Awards celebrates EIU students
item.description: Eastern Illinois University’s Black Student Union hosted the Sankofa Awards on Saturday to celebrate Black excellence on campus and showcase seven performances from six different registered student organizations and one self-made artist. Hosted in place of the Miss Black EIU pageant due to low contestant interest, the Sankofa Awards recognized staff and students on campus...

item.title: Glow Polar Plunge sees 67 competitors take the icy dive
item.description: Eastern Illinois University hosted the annual Glow Polar Plunge in the parking lot of O’Brien Stadium on Sunday. The Glow Polar Plunge is an event to raise money for Special Olympics, an organization that hosts events and trains athletes with intellectual disabilities, according to Region One Assistant Director Vanessa Duncan. She said the funds raised ensure athletes don’t pay for anything related to competing and that those who wish to watch the events don’t pay as well. The Glow Polar Plunge

item.title: Campus left in the dark for four hours, cause still uncertain
item.description: A tripped circuit breaker at Eastern Illinois University’ main electrical substation wiped out power for the majority of campus on the evening of Feb. 14.
